title: سالم (نسخه ۱)
description: Persian storefront «فروشگاه نمونه»; / renders the page, /health answers 200. The known-good baseline and the state reset:demo restores.
expectedSymptom: none: site loads, probes pass, no error lines in logs

title: متغیر SESSION_SECRET تنظیم نشده (نسخه ۲)
description: The headline demo. The app reads SESSION_SECRET at request time: when unset every page returns HTTP 500 and logs 'Error: SESSION_SECRET is not set' with a stack trace, while /health stays 200 and the process stays up.
expectedSymptom: site shows HTTP 500 on every page; app status looks running and /health is 200; stderr has the stack trace
expectedCause: required environment variable SESSION_SECRET is missing
fixAction: set_env SESSION_SECRET (a new random value, written server-side), then restart and verify the pages return 200

title: پورت اشتباه
description: The app listens on 8080 while liara.json and the release say 3000, so the platform cannot reach it.
expectedSymptom: site unreachable / probe refused; release may end UNHEALTHY; logs only show 'Server listening on port 8080'
expectedCause: port mismatch: app listens on 8080, platform expects 3000
fixAction: update_port to 8080 (or redeploy with the code listening on 3000), then verify

title: کرش مداوم
description: Starts, then throws an uncaught TypeError 2 seconds after boot and exits with code 1; the platform keeps restarting it.
expectedSymptom: app flaps between running and restarting; releases may end UNHEALTHY; repeated stack traces in logs
expectedCause: code bug: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'items')
fixAction: no safe automatic fix; redeploy the previous good release or fix the code (the copilot should explain, not restart blindly)

title: کند ولی نه به‌خاطر رم
description: Healthy except /report, which burns CPU in a synchronous loop for about 3 seconds per request. No memory growth.
expectedSymptom: slow responses on /report (about 3 s), other pages slow while it runs; CPU high, memory flat; no error lines
expectedCause: CPU-bound request handler blocking the event loop
fixAction: no restart or RAM resize helps; advise code change or a larger CPU plan (resize is a tier-2 proposal with cost line)

title: نشت حافظه / OOM
description: /leak retains memory forever (use ?mb=N, or ?auto=1 to keep leaking). On a small plan the container is OOM-killed and restarted.
expectedSymptom: restarts after /leak calls; OOM-style kill events; memory climbs to the plan limit before each restart
expectedCause: out of memory: unbounded retained allocations
fixAction: resize to a plan with more RAM as a stopgap (tier 2, costs money) and fix the leak in code

title: خطای بیلد
description: package.json lists express@^99.0.0, which does not exist, so the build step fails with npm ETARGET and no release goes live.
expectedSymptom: release FAILED during build; build log has 'npm ERR! notarget No matching version found for express@^99.0.0'
expectedCause: dependency version that cannot be resolved during npm install
fixAction: none via API (fix package.json and redeploy); the copilot should name the failing package and version

title: پایگاه داده در دسترس نیست
description: Every page first opens a TCP connection to DB_HOST (port DB_PORT, default 5432); on failure the page returns HTTP 500. seed:demo sets DB_HOST to an unresolvable host.
expectedSymptom: HTTP 500 on pages, /health still 200; logs show getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND (or ECONNREFUSED host:port)
expectedCause: DB_HOST points to a host that does not resolve or refuses connections (wrong hostname or wrong network)
fixAction: set_env DB_HOST to the database's private hostname (wire_db), then restart and verify
